forum.content_text:
I need the version that support programming the PSD311,as well as the DLPortIO driver.

Thanks.
forum.author: Peanut1996

scraped_replies.html:
Welcome @Peanut1996, to the community!

I’m very sorry, but all devices with PSD (Programmable System Device) have been discontinued without replacement for many years now, including the associated software. You may still find something in the depths of the Wayback Machine, or a friendly user may still have something, but unfortunately STMicroelectronics can no longer help you.

Sorry that I cannot give a more pleasant answer.

Regards
/Peter
